name: The Longest Journey
author: Nateus009
description: Game support for The Longest Journey (Steam/GOG). Installs mods to the game folder and ScummVM mods such as TLJ HD, its FMV packs and HD Characters, applies .tljpatch translations (e.g. Brazilian Portuguese) and starts the game in ScummVM when the enabled mods need it, downloading and configuring ScummVM if needed.
